Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O04
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer with institutional data steward
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: Withdrawal and any required erasure have explicit effects on current service and restored copies.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Implement durable quarantine/withdrawal controls and journal them independently; define current delivery, linked views, pending operations and derivative obligations without inferring permissions from provenance.
2. Document institution-specific retention, backup expiry, shared-blob reachability and any required physical-erasure procedure; keep automatic collection disabled unless separately qualified.
3. Back up, then withdraw/restrict data, lose the original host and restore: restricted content remains unavailable. Required erasure or source-evidence obligations that lack a qualified procedure block admission of affected data.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
